description: This file defines the LeavePeriodModel class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class implements the Normalizable interface and uses the ModelTrait to transform a LeavePeriod DTO into a serializable model, setting entity and filter attributes for API responses.

classes.name: LeavePeriodModel
classes.description: A model class that transforms a LeavePeriod data transfer object into a serializable format for API output, using filters and attribute mappings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LeavePeriodModel with a LeavePeriod entity, setting filters for start and end date getters, and mapping attribute names for serialization.
